%@ name :: Timetable Rescheduling after Earthquake (high‑speed railway)
%@ desc :: MILP model for post‑earthquake timetable rescheduling that captures track outages, track and station recovery, and time‑varying passenger demand. Binary variables indicate whether a train service is scheduled, whether a track segment or station is operational, and continuous variables measure unserved demand and delay. The objective minimizes a weighted sum of unmet demand and delay, encouraging fast recovery while respecting infrastructure availability.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Origin‑destination (OD) pairs.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Discrete time periods in the recovery horizon.
%@ index L ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Track segments.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.

%@ param travel shape=I kind=scalar domain=time :: Nominal travel time for OD pair (i,j) under normal conditions.
%@ param original_time shape=I kind=scalar domain=time :: Planned departure time for OD pair (i,j) in the original timetable.
%@ param time shape=T kind=scalar domain=time :: Absolute time value of period t (e.g., minutes from horizon start).
%@ param seg shape=I,L kind=matrix domain=bool :: Indicator =1 if track segment l belongs to the unique path of OD pair (i,j), otherwise 0.
%@ param sta shape=I,S kind=matrix domain=bool :: Indicator =1 if station s lies on the path of OD pair (i,j), otherwise 0.
%@ param init_track shape=L kind=vector domain=bool :: Initial operational status of each track segment (0 = out, 1 = functional) at the beginning of the horizon.
%@ param init_station shape=S kind=vector domain=bool :: Initial operational status of each station at the beginning of the horizon.
%@ param alpha shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Weight for unserved demand in the objective.
%@ param beta shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Weight for delay in the objective.
%@ var x shape=I,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: 1 if a train serving OD pair (i,j) is scheduled in period t.
%@ var y shape=L,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: 1 if track segment l is operational (recovered) in period t.
%@ var z shape=S,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: 1 if station s is operational (recovered) in period t.
%@ var u shape=I,T domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Unserved passenger demand for OD pair (i,j) in period t.
%@ var delta shape=I,T domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Delay (in time units) of the scheduled service for OD pair (i,j) in period t relative to the original timetable.
%@ obj sense=min name=resilience_score combination=sum :: Minimize weighted sum of unmet demand and service delay.
%@ con service_track kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Service can be scheduled only if every required track segment is operational.
%@ con service_station kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Service can be scheduled only if every required station is operational.
%@ con unserved_demand kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of unserved demand.
%@ con service_delay kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of service delay.
%@ con track_monotonic kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Once a track segment is recovered it stays recovered.
%@ con station_monotonic kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Once a station is recovered it stays recovered.
%@ con init_track_status kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Initial status of each track segment.
%@ con init_station_status kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Initial status of each station.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I},\, j \in \mathcal{I},\, t \in \mathcal{T}} \bigl( \mathit{alpha} \cdot u_{i,j,t} + \mathit{beta} \cdot \delta_{i,j,t} \bigr) \tag{resilience_score} \\
  & x_{i,j,t} \le y_{l,t} + \bigl(1 - \mathit{seg}_{i,j,l}\bigr) \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{service_track} \\
  & x_{i,j,t} \le z_{s,t} + \bigl(1 - \mathit{sta}_{i,j,s}\bigr) \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{service_station} \\
  & u_{i,j,t} \ge \mathit{demand}_{i,j,t} - \mathit{demand}_{i,j,t} \cdot x_{i,j,t} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{unserved_demand} \\
  & \delta_{i,j,t} \ge \bigl( \mathit{time}_{t} - \mathit{original\_time}_{i,j} \bigr) \cdot x_{i,j,t} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{service_delay} \\
  & y_{l,t} \ge y_{l,t-1} \qquad \forall l \in \mathcal{L},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; t > 0 \tag{track_monotonic} \\
  & z_{s,t} \ge z_{s,t-1} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; t > 0 \tag{station_monotonic} \\
  & y_{l,0} = \mathit{init\_track}_{l} \qquad \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{init_track_status} \\
  & z_{s,0} = \mathit{init\_station}_{s} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{init_station_status}
\end{align}
